learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition and development of basic motor skills and abilities in selected sports: skiing and snowboarding.
Mastering the correct technique of performing individual movements, which are necessary for skiing and snowboarding.

assessment_rules: Grades: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The condition for the award of 1 or 2 credits is the completion of a multi-day course in its full scope, or the completion of one-day courses in the scope of 4 days.
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
